paragraphs: A Next.js landing page with scroll animations and an on-page cart, backed by your WooCommerce store.
features: Animations: GSAP ScrollTrigger (pinned hero, horizontal scroll, product reveals), Lenis smooth scrolling, Motion for the cart drawer. Respects reduced-motion.
Products: read from the WooCommerce Store API, refreshed every 15 minutes. Until WOOURL is set, demo products and a demo cart are used so the page can be tried end to end.

Team themes: the hero lets visitors pick McLaren, Ferrari or Red Bull. The helmet swaps and the site's accent colours change; the choice is remembered on their device. Colours are in src/app/globals.css under…

Driver figures: each figure is two transparent layers on the same frame, -body.webp and -helmet.webp in public/images. The helmet floats above the body; hovering with a mouse drops it onto the neck. seat in…

Featured items: the hero, driver series and MCL-40 sections are set up in src/lib/showcase.ts. Each item's slug must match the product's slug in WooCommerce so its Add to cart button uses the real product and price.
